This submission contains seven (7) emission maps in 0.25 deg Cartesian pixelization. We used 38 energy bins for the inner 140 deg x 140 deg galactic sky (centered at the galactic center).
The energy bins are logarithmically spaced by a factor of 1.2996566. The first bin starts at 0.0438587 GeV (it is centered at 0.050 GeV). See specific list below.

Units are in GeV cm^-2 s^-1 sr^-1 i.e. E^2*dPhi/dE

The maps are for: 

the Loop I "dim shell":

LoopI_Dim_Shell_flux_140x140_E_50-814009_MeV_Cartesian.fits

Loop I "bright shell":

LoopI_Bright_Shell_flux_140x140_E_50-814009_MeV_Cartesian.fits

Combined LoopI dim and bright shells:

LoopI_Combined_flux_140x140_E_50-814009_MeV_Cartesian.fits

For the description of the assumptions on the Loop I shells read section III of the paper.

Also:

The Flat Bubbles:

Bubbles_Edges_Alternative_E_flux_140x140_E_50-814009_MeV_Cartesian.fits

The Inner Bubbles:

BubblesInner_with_Boundaries_EmissStoN_1_a_2p5kpc_b_4p3kpc_x0_6p2kpc_pitch_0deg_yaw_0deg_flux_140x140_E_50-814009_MeV_Cartesian.fits

The Cocoons:

Cocoons_EmissStoN_10_a_2p0kpc_b_1p0kpc_x0_3p5kpc_pitch_35deg_yaw_-29deg_flux_140x140_E_50-814009_MeV_Cartesian.fits

using in each case their best-fit properties. For the description on those see section V of the paper.

Combining the Flat Bubbles, the Inner Bubbles and the Cocoons based on their relative normalizations (as described in Table IX of the paper) gives:

Combined_Bubbles_and_Cocoons_BestFit_flux_140x140_E_50-814009_MeV_Cartesian.fits
